metadata.description: Diego Eis's plugins for team management and content creation.

plugins.name: eis-manager-assistant
plugins.description: Status reports with verifiable sources for leaders who follow teams, forums and people.

plugins.name: eis-content-builder
plugins.description: Writing assistant that learns your voice and produces content for blogs, LinkedIn, newsletters and other channels.

plugins.name: eis-plugin-skeleton
plugins.description: Creates the folder structure of a plugin project for Claude Code and Cowork: src/ as the plugin root, docs/, scripts/pack.sh and versioned builds in dist/.

plugins.name: eis-daily-brief
plugins.description: Daily brief note from calendar, messenger, e-mail, meeting notes and reports: tasks, pending issues by person and important topics, with tasks closed automatically when the source shows they were done.
